questions.text: People should take into consideration evidence that goes against their beliefs.
It is important to persevere in your beliefs even when evidence is brought to bear against them.
One should disregard evidence that conflicts with your established beliefs.
Beliefs should always be revised in response to new information or evidence.
Changing your mind is a sign of weakness.

moderate.label: Moderate open-mindedness
moderate.description: Some resistance to biases, room for improvement

low.label: Low open-mindedness
low.description: May be susceptible to confirmation bias

instructions: Please indicate how much you agree or disagree with each statement.
